description: Compact inline SVG mini-chart for a single data series. Renders Line, Bar, Area, or Pie variants and shows an empty state when no data is supplied; sized to fit inline within tables, cards, or text. The default stroke/fill and the Pie slice palette resolve the token-driven chart series palette (--tm-chart-series-1..8, theme-relative since TG-002); Color overrides the stroke/fill with any CSS colour and renders verbatim. A serialized sparkline SVG carries those var(--tm-chart-*) references, resolved only under the Tempo stylesheet: before serializing, copy getComputedStyle(el).fill/.stroke onto each node as attributes (like _bakePaints in wireframe-designer.js), or override the tokens on the exported root.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: Root element of the sparkline box. TmRootElement.Div (default) keeps the historical <div>; TmRootElement.Span renders a phrasing <span> root and a phrasing subtree, for a sparkline inside a whole-card <a>/<button>.
